label: Visual
tagline: Images, icons, illustrations, decorative ambient motion
description: Classifies every visual slot (img, background-image, canvas, declared shader/lottie/3d paths) by medium and dispatches one per-medium drawer per slot. Modes: HTML-enumeration (post source-write) and (chat-triggered ad-hoc image requests). Step 8 QA checks style coherence + composition + cutout + text contrast after assets land. v3.5: reads pe_photo_<slotId> and pe_illust_<slotId> enrichment nodes from photography-orchestrator / illustration-orchestrator (if they ran upstream) and uses their outputs.promptForRasterPhoto / outputs.promptForRasterForeground verbatim as the prompt for the corresponding raster-photo / raster-foreground slot. Slots without enrichments fall back to the default un-enriched prompt - photography + illustration are degrade-gracefully, visual never depends on them.

triggers.title: build an app/page" with visual slots
triggers.rule: After source HTML is scaffolded (by /prototype skill or top-level Claude), dispatch visual-orchestrator against the source tree for HTML-enumeration. The orchestrator enumerates / background-image / canvas / inline-svg slots and dispatches one per-medium drawer per slot.
